en: We'll be here dealing with Samson's pride in the meantime~
ja: その間、こっちはサムソンのプライドの相手でもしてるから～

key: RINGMASTER: All right, and that's Round 2!
en: RINGMASTER: All right, and that's Round 2!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: はい、以上、第2回戦でした!

key: RINGMASTER: Congrats to everyone who's made it this far except Samson!
en: RINGMASTER: Congrats to everyone who's made it this far except Samson!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: ここまで勝ち残ったみんな、おめでとう――サムソン以外はね!

key: SAMSON: Keep talkin', lass.
en: SAMSON: Keep talkin', lass.
ja: サムソン: 言ってろ、お嬢。

key: MELOETTA: Melemele~
en: MELOETTA: Melemele~
ja: メロエッタ: メレメレ～

key: SAMSON: You tell her.
en: SAMSON: You tell her.
ja: サムソン: だよな。

key: RINGMASTER: Now we'll announce the pairings for Round 3!
en: RINGMASTER: Now we'll announce the pairings for Round 3!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: では、第3回戦の組み合わせを発表するわね!

key: "Clarice" VS \PN!
en: "Clarice" VS \PN!
ja: 「クラリス」 VS \PN!

key: "Mystery Participant" VS Break!
en: "Mystery Participant" VS Break!
ja: 「なぞの参加者」 VS ブレーク!

key: Samson's Pride VS Cass!
en: Samson's Pride VS Cass!
ja: サムソンのプライド VS キャス!

key: SAMSON: Beg your pardon?
en: SAMSON: Beg your pardon?
ja: サムソン: もう一回言ってみろ?

key: RINGMASTER: And Lumi VS Santiago!
en: RINGMASTER: And Lumi VS Santiago!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: そしてルミ VS サンティアゴ!

key: SANTIAGO: Fuck yeah! Let's fuckin' go!
en: SANTIAGO: Fuck yeah! Let's fuckin' go!
ja: サンティアゴ: よっしゃ、くそ最高だ! 行くぞコラ!

key: I'mma fuck this fuckin' shit all the way up!
en: I'mma fuck this fuckin' shit all the way up!
ja: このクソ野郎、完膚なきまでにブチのめしてやる!

key: All for that fuckin' Meloetta, you hear?!
en: All for that fuckin' Meloetta, you hear?!
ja: 全部あのクソ可愛いメロエッタのためだ、聞こえてんのか!?

key: LUMI: O-oh.
en: LUMI: O-oh.
ja: ルミ: あ、あの……

key: RINGMASTER: That's it!
en: RINGMASTER: That's it!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: 以上よ!

key: Good luck to everyone!
en: Good luck to everyone!
ja: みんな、頑張ってね!

key: RINGMASTER: Isn't it awfully generous of me to host a whole tournament to give others the chance to appreciate Meloetta?!
en: RINGMASTER: Isn't it awfully generous of me to host a whole tournament to give others the chance to appreciate Meloetta?!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: みんながメロエッタを堪能できるように、大会まで開いてあげるなんて、あたしってすごく太っ腹じゃない!?

key: I think it is.
en: I think it is.
ja: そう思うわ。

key: The things we do for Meloetta~
en: The things we do for Meloetta~
ja: メロエッタのためなら、これくらい～

key: ...And for the business!
en: ...And for the business!
ja: ……あと、商売のためにもね!

key: RINGMASTER: All right, let's go over the results of Round 3 as we move into the semifinals!
en: RINGMASTER: All right, let's go over the results of Round 3 as we move into the semifinals!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: それじゃ、準決勝に入る前に第3回戦の結果を振り返りましょう!

key: RINGMASTER: In the first match, \PN trounced the robo-Breloom known as Clarice!
en: RINGMASTER: In the first match, \PN trounced the robo-Breloom known as Clarice!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: 第1試合、\PNがロボキノガッサの「クラリス」を完膚なきまでにたたきのめしました!

key: SAMSON: Anyone know why that thing was here in the first place?
en: SAMSON: Anyone know why that thing was here in the first place?
ja: サムソン: そもそもあいつが何でここにいたのか、誰か知ってるのか?

key: LUMI: I guess it just really liked Meloetta?
en: LUMI: I guess it just really liked Meloetta?
ja: ルミ: メロエッタのことが、よっぽど好きだったとか?

key: RINGMASTER: In the second match, Break was knocked out by our Mystery Participant!
en: RINGMASTER: In the second match, Break was knocked out by our Mystery Participant!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: 第2試合、ブレークが「なぞの参加者」にノックアウトされました!

key: CASS: Subtlety's really not your thing, huh.
en: CASS: Subtlety's really not your thing, huh.
ja: キャス: あんたって、控えめってものを知らないのね。

key: RINGMASTER: In the third match, Samson's Pride was eliminated by Cass!
en: RINGMASTER: In the third match, Samson's Pride was eliminated by Cass!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: 第3試合、サムソンのプライドがキャスによって敗退!

key: SAMSON: ...
en: SAMSON: ...
ja: サムソン: ……

key: RINGMASTER: Just, absolutely stepped on and destroyed!
en: RINGMASTER: Just, absolutely stepped on and destroyed!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: もう、完全に踏みにじられて粉々になったわ!

key: Really hard to overstate just how thoroughly Samson's Pride was thrashed!
en: Really hard to overstate just how thoroughly Samson's Pride was thrashed!
ja: サムソンのプライドがどれだけ徹底的にたたきのめされたか、言葉では言い表せないくらいよ!

key: SAMSON: Okay, you can stop now...
en: SAMSON: Okay, you can stop now...
ja: サムソン: おい、もういいから……

key: CASS: No, no; go on.
en: CASS: No, no; go on.
ja: キャス: いいから、続けて。

key: RINGMASTER: Of the top 10 humiliating defeats we've ever had here at the Agate Circus,
en: RINGMASTER: Of the top 10 humiliating defeats we've ever had here at the Agate Circus,
ja: サーカスだんちょう: このアゲートサーカス史上、屈辱的な敗北ランキングトップ10があるとしたら、

key: Why, I'd say Samson's Pride suffered the worst out of all of them!
en: Why, I'd say Samson's Pride suffered the worst out of all of them!
ja: サムソンのプライドは、間違いなくその中でも最悪の一つだったって言えるわね!

key: But some might say that was bound to happen to someone like Samson's Pride.
en: But some might say that was bound to happen to someone like Samson's Pride.
ja: まあ、サムソンのプライドみたいな相手には、起こるべくして起きたことかもしれないけど。

key: SAMSON: You're gonna need to find yourself a new bouncer.
en: SAMSON: You're gonna need to find yourself a new bouncer.
ja: サムソン: お前、新しい用心棒を探す羽目になるぞ。

key: RINGMASTER: Okay, okay-- and in the fourth match, Lumi prevailed against Santiago!
en: RINGMASTER: Okay, okay-- and in the fourth match, Lumi prevailed against Santiago!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: はいはい――そして第4試合、ルミがサンティアゴに勝利しました!

key: LUMI: He taught me a new word!
en: LUMI: He taught me a new word!
ja: ルミ: 新しい言葉、教えてもらっちゃいました!

key: MELOETTA: Melo!
en: MELOETTA: Melo!
ja: メロエッタ: メロ!

key: RINGMASTER: Meloetta's right! This show needs to keep moving!
en: RINGMASTER: Meloetta's right! This show needs to keep moving!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: メロエッタの言う通り! ショーは止まらないわよ!

key: So the semifinal pairs!
en: So the semifinal pairs!
ja: というわけで、準決勝の組み合わせ!

key: \PN VS "Mystery Participant"!
en: \PN VS "Mystery Participant"!
ja: \PN VS 「なぞの参加者」!

key: Cass VS Lumi!
en: Cass VS Lumi!
ja: キャス VS ルミ!

key: Let's hop to it!
en: Let's hop to it!
ja: さあ、始めましょう!

key: RINGMASTER: Not long now!
en: RINGMASTER: Not long now!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: もうすぐよ!

key: RINGMASTER: The semifinals are over!
en: RINGMASTER: The semifinals are over!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: 準決勝、終了!

key: Let's go over the results!
en: Let's go over the results!
ja: 結果を振り返りましょう!

key: First up--
en: First up--
ja: まずは――

key: CASS: The results are apparent.
en: CASS: The results are apparent.
ja: キャス: 結果は見ての通りよ。

key: The final match is me and \PN.
en: The final match is me and \PN.
ja: 決勝はあたしと\PN。

key: Let's just get to it already.
en: Let's just get to it already.
ja: さっさと始めましょ。

key: SAMSON: ...Aaand in the last match, the Ringmaster's Pride was utterly destroyed by Cass.
en: SAMSON: ...Aaand in the last match, the Ringmaster's Pride was utterly destroyed by Cass.
ja: サムソン: ……で、最後の試合は、団長のプライドがキャスに完膚なきまでにたたきのめされたとさ。

key: RINGMASTER: But-- the fanfare...
en: RINGMASTER: But-- the fanfare...
ja: サーカスだんちょう: でも――ファンファーレは……

key: Oh, fine.
en: Oh, fine.
ja: ああ、もういいわ。

key: I thought more people would be sticking around after elimination anyway...
en: I thought more people would be sticking around after elimination anyway...
ja: そもそも、敗退した後もみんな残ってくれると思ってたのに……

key: Maybe they're just down in the main area, buying merchandise?
en: Maybe they're just down in the main area, buying merchandise?
ja: きっとメイン会場でグッズでも買ってるのよ、きっと。

key: SAMSON: Yeah, I don't know about all that.
en: SAMSON: Yeah, I don't know about all that.
ja: サムソン: いや、それはどうかな。

key: RINGMASTER: But... my sales...
en: RINGMASTER: But... my sales...
ja: サーカスだんちょう: でも……あたしの売上が……

key: RINGMASTER: What about my sales...?
en: RINGMASTER: What about my sales...?
ja: サーカスだんちょう: あたしの売上、どうなるのよ……?

key: RINGMASTER: So, that's it! Tournament's over!
en: RINGMASTER: So, that's it! Tournament's over!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: はい、以上! 大会終了よ!

key: Congratulations to our winner, \PN!
en: Congratulations to our winner, \PN!
ja: 優勝者は\PN、おめでとう!

key: ...She says to the remaining crowd of... nobody.
en: ...She says to the remaining crowd of... nobody.
ja: ……と、誰もいない観客に向かって言ってみる。

key: SAMSON: I'm right here.
en: SAMSON: I'm right here.
ja: サムソン: 俺はここにいるぞ。

key: RINGMASTER: Samson, I'd say something like "You don't count," but it really doesn't do the extent to which you do not count any remote justice.
en: RINGMASTER: Samson, I'd say something like "You don't count," but it really doesn't do the extent to which you do not count any remote justice.
ja: サーカスだんちょう: サムソン、「あなたは数に入らない」って言いたいところだけど、それじゃあなたがどれだけ数に入らないか、全然言い表せてないわね。

key: Pre-schoolers count better than you do.
en: Pre-schoolers count better than you do.
ja: 幼稚園児の方が、まだ数えるのが上手いくらいよ。

key: The fenceposts count more than you do.
en: The fenceposts count more than you do.
ja: 柵のくいの方が、あなたより数に入るわ。

key: That pebble over there on the ground?
en: That pebble over there on the ground?
ja: あそこに転がってる小石、あるでしょ?

key: That counts more than you do.
en: That counts more than you do.
ja: あれの方が、あなたより数に入るわよ。

key: Just move out of the way so that \PN can get their promised autograph.
en: Just move out of the way so that \PN can get their promised autograph.
ja: いいから退いて、\PNが約束のサインをもらえるようにして。

key: SAMSON: I thought you'd never ask.
en: SAMSON: I thought you'd never ask.
ja: サムソン: 言われるのを待ってたところだ。

key: RINGMASTER: ...You won't do something silly like, just catch the Pokémon, right?
en: RINGMASTER: ...You won't do something silly like, just catch the Pokémon, right?
ja: サーカスだんちょう: ……まさか、ポケモンを勝手に捕まえるとか、そんなバカなことしないわよね?

key: You know it's the circus' property now, right?
en: You know it's the circus' property now, right?
ja: もうサーカスの所有物だって、分かってるでしょ?

key: Who cares if it has a probably-dangerous possibly mind-altering Anomaly attached to it!
en: Who cares if it has a probably-dangerous possibly mind-altering Anomaly attached to it!
ja: たとえ危険で、精神に作用するかもしれないアノマリーがくっついてても、そんなの関係ないわ!

key: ...Haha?
en: ...Haha?
ja: ……あはは?

key: RINGMASTER: Wow, \PN, I was sure you'd win!
en: RINGMASTER: Wow, \PN, I was sure you'd win!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: わあ、\PN、あなたが勝つと思ってたのに!

key: Kinda relieved if I'm being honest-- I didn't want you to try and take this thing away from us.
en: Kinda relieved if I'm being honest-- I didn't want you to try and take this thing away from us.
ja: 正直ちょっとホッとしてるわ――この子を取り上げられずに済んだんだから。

key: It's for the good of the circus!
en: It's for the good of the circus!
ja: サーカスのためなんだもの!

key: But Cass already came and got the autograph and left, so your ship has unfortunately sailed!
en: But Cass already came and got the autograph and left, so your ship has unfortunately sailed!
ja: でもキャスがもうサインをもらって帰っちゃったから、残念だけどあなたのチャンスは逃げちゃったわね!

key: That's okay-- try again next tournament, maybe!
en: That's okay-- try again next tournament, maybe!
ja: でも大丈夫――また次の大会で挑戦してみたら!

key: Until then, right?
en: Until then, right?
ja: それまでのお楽しみってことで、ね?

key: SAMSON: You serious right now?
en: SAMSON: You serious right now?
ja: サムソン: マジで言ってるのか?

key: You know these Anomaly things can be dangerous, right?
en: You know these Anomaly things can be dangerous, right?
ja: アノマリーってやつが危険だってこと、分かってるよな?

key: RINGMASTER: B-but the profits!
en: RINGMASTER: B-but the profits!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: で、でももうけが!

key: The attraction!
en: The attraction!
ja: 目玉アトラクションが!

key: SAMSON: Yeah, forget this.
en: SAMSON: Yeah, forget this.
ja: サムソン: ああ、もういい。

key: \PN may not have won, but the Champion is the person best suited to clean up these messes.
en: \PN may not have won, but the Champion is the person best suited to clean up these messes.
ja: \PNは優勝しなかったが、こういう厄介事の後始末に一番向いてるのはチャンピオンだ。

key: If you want to safeguard it so badly, you can be your own bouncer.
en: If you want to safeguard it so badly, you can be your own bouncer.
ja: そんなに守りたいなら、自分で用心棒でもやればいい。

key: I'm out. See you next show.
en: I'm out. See you next show.
ja: 俺は降りる。次のショーでまたな。

key: RINGMASTER: Wait wait wait, seriously?!
en: RINGMASTER: Wait wait wait, seriously?!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: ちょっと待って待って、マジで!?

key: You're doing this now?!
en: You're doing this now?!
ja: こんなときに辞めるつもり!?

key: But what about the --
en: But what about the --
ja: でもそれじゃ――

key: RINGMASTER: ...Ugh.
en: RINGMASTER: ...Ugh.
ja: サーカスだんちょう: ……うう。

key: Fine, do whatever you want.
en: Fine, do whatever you want.
ja: もういいわ、好きにして。

key: I guess.
en: I guess.
ja: どうせそうなるんでしょうけど。

key: ...You'll catch Legendary Pokémon, taking away from the circus' valuable appeal, but you won't pet a Glaceon...
en: ...You'll catch Legendary Pokémon, taking away from the circus' valuable appeal, but you won't pet a Glaceon...
ja: ……伝説のポケモンは捕まえて、サーカスの貴重な目玉を奪っておいて、グレイシアはなでようともしないのね……

key: Yeah, she told me too.
en: Yeah, she told me too.
ja: ええ、あたしにもその話、聞かせてもらったし。

key: But I'm not here to judge.
en: But I'm not here to judge.
ja: でも別に、批判するつもりはないわよ。

key: I'll still do it, but it's not what I'm here for...
en: I'll still do it, but it's not what I'm here for...
ja: やることはやるけど、それが本題じゃないっていうか……

key: Just do whatever you want, I guess.
en: Just do whatever you want, I guess.
ja: とにかく、好きにすればいいわ。

key: RINGMASTER: Y-you should probably just catch the thing...
en: RINGMASTER: Y-you should probably just catch the thing...
ja: サーカスだんちょう: そ、そのポケモンは捕まえておいた方がいいと思うけど……

key: Maybe consider donating it?
en: Maybe consider donating it?
ja: 寄付するとか、考えてみたら?

key: ...Maybe not...
en: ...Maybe not...
ja: ……やっぱりなしね……

key: RINGMASTER: Maybe this thing is making me moody...
en: RINGMASTER: Maybe this thing is making me moody...
ja: サーカスだんちょう: このポケモンのせいで、あたしまで機嫌が悪くなってるのかも……

key: SAMSON: Sorry, champ-- I can't let even you through here.
en: SAMSON: Sorry, champ-- I can't let even you through here.
ja: サムソン: すまんな、チャンプ――あんたでも、ここは通せない。

key: Boss's orders.
en: Boss's orders.
ja: お嬢の命令でな。

key: This thing showed up here this morning and the moment she laid claim to it, I swear you could see her pupils morph into dollar signs.
en: This thing showed up here this morning and the moment she laid claim to it, I swear you could see her pupils morph into dollar signs.
ja: こいつは今朝ここに現れてな、お嬢が自分のものだって言い張った瞬間、目ん玉がドル記号に変わったのが見えたぞ、マジで。

key: I've got a hunch that this is gonna be a short term deal only, so forgive me for not breaking contract for you right off the bat.
en: I've got a hunch that this is gonna be a short term deal only, so forgive me for not breaking contract for you right off the bat.
ja: どうせ長続きしないと踏んでるから、今すぐお前のために契約を破るのは勘弁してくれ。

key: But you better believe if this goes on too long, we'll be talking again.
en: But you better believe if this goes on too long, we'll be talking again.
ja: だがこれが長引くようなら、また話し合うことになるだろうよ。

key: SAMSON: So I'm up against that Percy girl, huh...
en: SAMSON: So I'm up against that Percy girl, huh...
ja: サムソン: つまり俺の相手は、あのパーシーってお嬢ちゃんか……

key: Something tells me it won't be much of a match.
en: Something tells me it won't be much of a match.
ja: 大した勝負にはならなそうな予感がするな。

key: SAMSON: See you in the finals, \PN.
en: SAMSON: See you in the finals, \PN.
ja: サムソン: 決勝で会おうぜ、\PN。

key: SAMSON: Sometimes I wonder why I put up with all this.
en: SAMSON: Sometimes I wonder why I put up with all this.
ja: サムソン: 時々、何でこんなことに耐えてるのか分からなくなるな。

key: SAMSON: We done here yet?
en: SAMSON: We done here yet?
ja: サムソン: もう終わりか?

key: LUMI: Hi, \PN!
en: LUMI: Hi, \PN!
ja: ルミ: こんにちは、\PN!

key: Cass and I were just talking about Glaceon and how cute and talented it is!
en: Cass and I were just talking about Glaceon and how cute and talented it is!
ja: キャスと、グレイシアがどれだけ可愛くて才能があるかって話してたんです!

key: It's really saved me in a few tight spots when we've been out hunting Legendaries a few times too!
en: It's really saved me in a few tight spots when we've been out hunting Legendaries a few times too!
ja: 伝説のポケモンを追いかけてるときも、何度もピンチを救ってくれたんですよ!

key: LUMI: This is the first time I'm really fighting on my own!
en: LUMI: This is the first time I'm really fighting on my own!
ja: ルミ: 自分の力だけで本気で戦うの、これが初めてなんです!

key: I've learned a lot from my sister, and--
en: I've learned a lot from my sister, and--
ja: お姉ちゃんからもたくさん教わったし、それに――

key: Well, even from Zero too.
en: Well, even from Zero too.
ja: まあ、ゼロからも色々教わりました。

key: But do you really think it's enough to stand among the best of them?
en: But do you really think it's enough to stand among the best of them?
ja: でも、それだけでトップクラスに並べると思いますか?

key: LUMI: Wow, I'm really pulling through!
en: LUMI: Wow, I'm really pulling through!
ja: ルミ: わあ、意外といけてます!

key: I gotta tell Eve when I see her!
en: I gotta tell Eve when I see her!
ja: 今度イヴに会ったら、教えてあげなきゃ!

key: LUMI: Good luck!
en: LUMI: Good luck!
ja: ルミ: がんばってください!

key: I'm gonna do my best in this one too!
en: I'm gonna do my best in this one too!
ja: あたしも、今回精一杯がんばりますから!

key: JULIA: Hi \PN!
en: JULIA: Hi \PN!
ja: ジュリア: どうも、\PN!

key: I wasn't originally gonna come to the circus today, but then I suddenly felt a calling.
en: I wasn't originally gonna come to the circus today, but then I suddenly felt a calling.
ja: 今日はサーカスに来るつもりなかったんだけど、急に呼ばれてる気がして。

key: Like I had to be here...
en: Like I had to be here...
ja: ここに来なきゃいけないって、そんな感じ……

key: Like there was missed screen time to make up for!
en: Like there was missed screen time to make up for!
ja: 取り戻さなきゃいけない出番があるみたいな!

key: Do you ever get that feeling? Is that just me?
en: Do you ever get that feeling? Is that just me?
ja: そういう感覚、あなたもある? それともあたしだけ?

key: Or did someone misplace a wall somewhere?
en: Or did someone misplace a wall somewhere?

en: She can sign more than one autograph, can't she?
ja: 彼女、サインくらい何枚でもしてくれるんじゃないの?

key: I'll admit it's good business sense, but this kind of forced scarcity for the sake of profit...
en: I'll admit it's good business sense, but this kind of forced scarcity for the sake of profit...
ja: 商売としちゃ賢いとは思うけど、こういう利益目当ての人為的な品薄商法って……

key: It just doesn't sit right with me.
en: It just doesn't sit right with me.
ja: なんかしっくりこないのよね。

key: I'll still give it my all though-- I need that 'graph!
en: I'll still give it my all though-- I need that 'graph!
ja: それでも全力は尽くすけどね――あのサインが欲しいの!

key: Oh dear.
en: Oh dear.
ja: あらまあ。

key: It seems that mechanical Pokémon tried to register...
en: It seems that mechanical Pokémon tried to register...
ja: あのメカポケモン、登録しようとしたみたいね……

key: But where it tried to sign its name, it punched a hole straight through the paper instead.
en: But where it tried to sign its name, it punched a hole straight through the paper instead.
ja: でもサインするはずのところに、紙に穴をぶち開けちゃったみたい。

key: I suppose it is a... creative form of signature.
en: I suppose it is a... creative form of signature.
ja: まあ、それも……独創的なサインの形と言えなくもないわね。

key: I pray that Meloetta's is more elegant-- no! There's no doubt it will be!
en: I pray that Meloetta's is more elegant-- no! There's no doubt it will be!
ja: メロエッタのサインはもっと優雅であることを祈るわ――いえ、きっとそうに違いない!

key: But if it is not... I shall accept it with grace!
en: But if it is not... I shall accept it with grace!
ja: でももしそうじゃなくても……あたしは優雅に受け止めてみせるから!

key: You could travel all these mountains and never find a treasure quite like the one offered to us today!
en: You could travel all these mountains and never find a treasure quite like the one offered to us today!
ja: この山々をどれだけ旅しても、今日もらえるような宝には、二度と出会えないだろうさ!

key: Tell you what, Trainer, I'll be getting that autograph!
en: Tell you what, Trainer, I'll be getting that autograph!
ja: 言っとくが、トレーナーさん、あのサインは俺がもらうぜ!

key: Isn't Meloetta soooooo cute?!
en: Isn't Meloetta soooooo cute?!
ja: メロエッタってめちゃくちゃ可愛くない!?

key: I bet Meloetta's the kind of Pokémon that would dot its I's with hearts!
en: I bet Meloetta's the kind of Pokémon that would dot its I's with hearts!
ja: メロエッタってきっと、アイのところをハートで書くタイプのポケモンだよね!

key: It doesn't have any I's in its name, but...
en: It doesn't have any I's in its name, but...
ja: 名前に「アイ」なんて入ってないけど……

key: We could add some!
en: We could add some!
ja: 足しちゃえばいいのよ!

key: Miloetta!
en: Miloetta!
ja: ミロエッタ!

key: Meloitta?
en: Meloitta?
ja: メロイッタ?

key: Millitti?
en: Millitti?
ja: ミリッティ?

key: Miiiilittiii?
en: Miiiilittiii?
ja: ミィィリッティィ?

key: Hmm....
en: Hmm....
ja: うーん……

key: Okay! Time to get ahead by staking out the competition in advance!
en: Okay! Time to get ahead by staking out the competition in advance!
ja: よし! 先に相手を偵察しておかなきゃ!

key: RINGMASTER: Hey, order! Down in front!
en: RINGMASTER: Hey, order! Down in front!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: ちょっと、静かに! 前に出過ぎ!

key: MELOETTA: Miii~
en: MELOETTA: Miii~
ja: メロエッタ: ミーィ～

key: RINGMASTER: That means you too, princess!
en: RINGMASTER: That means you too, princess!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: それ、あなたのことも言ってるのよ、お姫様!

key: You're the least orderly and most in front of them all!
en: You're the least orderly and most in front of them all!
ja: 一番静かじゃなくて、一番前に出てるのがあなたなんだから!

key: MELOETTA: Looo?
en: MELOETTA: Looo?
ja: メロエッタ: ロォ?

key: RINGMASTER: Don't give me that face!
en: RINGMASTER: Don't give me that face!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: その顔しないで!

key: MISS PERCY: Give me that face instead!
en: MISS PERCY: Give me that face instead!
ja: ミス・パーシー: その顔ならあたしにちょうだい!

key: SANTIAGO: So fuckin' cute!
en: SANTIAGO: So fuckin' cute!
ja: サンティアゴ: クソ可愛すぎるだろ!

key: SAMSON: Hey now, everybody's gonna need to back off.
en: SAMSON: Hey now, everybody's gonna need to back off.
ja: サムソン: おい、みんな下がってくれ。

key: BEE: How much for an autograph?!
en: BEE: How much for an autograph?!
ja: ビー: サイン一枚、いくらで買える!?

key: BREAK: Forget one autograph; how much for twenty?
en: BREAK: Forget one autograph; how much for twenty?
ja: ブレーク: サイン一枚どころか、20枚でいくらだ?

key: The resale's gonna be one heck of a profit.
en: The resale's gonna be one heck of a profit.
ja: 転売したら、とんでもないもうけになるぜ。

key: RINGMASTER: Hey, no scalping!
en: RINGMASTER: Hey, no scalping!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: ちょっと、ダフ屋行為はダメ!

key: The real deal's the only one that's any good anyway! Get it while it's hot, folks!
en: The real deal's the only one that's any good anyway!  Get it while it's hot, folks!
ja: 結局、本物にはかなわないんだから! みんな、熱いうちにどうぞ!

key: But get first-- get in a line or something, geez!
en: But get first-- get in a line or something, geez!
ja: でも先に――ちゃんと並んでちょうだい、もう!

key: MCKREZZY: An autograph won't do you an ounce of good compared to that sweet song~
en: MCKREZZY: An autograph won't do you an ounce of good compared to that sweet song~
ja: マクレジー: サインなんて、あの甘い歌声には遠く及ばないさ～

key: Say, Meloetta, would you be interested in a collab?
en: Say, Meloetta, would you be interested in a collab?
ja: なあ、メロエッタ、コラボしてみる気はないか?

key: MELOETTA: Miiii?
en: MELOETTA: Miiii?
ja: メロエッタ: ミーィ?

key: RINGMASTER: Ugh, what's gotten into you all...
en: RINGMASTER: Ugh, what's gotten into you all...
ja: サーカスだんちょう: もう、みんなどうしちゃったのよ……

key: LUMI: Meloetta's just really cute!
en: LUMI: Meloetta's just really cute!
ja: ルミ: メロエッタ、ほんとに可愛いんだもん!

key: JULIA: It also has fantastic hair!
en: JULIA: It also has fantastic hair!
ja: ジュリア: 髪の毛だって最高なのよ!

key: Meloetta, you've gotta tell me what shampoo you use!
en: Meloetta, you've gotta tell me what shampoo you use!
ja: メロエッタ、シャンプー何使ってるか教えてよ!

key: Is it the magic song powers? I bet it's the magic song powers.
en: Is it the magic song powers? I bet it's the magic song powers.
ja: それって魔法の歌の力なの? 絶対そうよ。

key: I bet every morning you hop out of the shower and are just like "Meeee~" and then your hair goes all swoooosh and flows behind you and detangles like some kind of magical girl transformation like "Maybe she's born with it; Maybe it's Meloetta"-- hey, I bet if I could get a bottle of that, I wouldn't have half the troubled boy problems I have!
en: I bet every morning you hop out of the shower and are just like "Meeee~" and then your hair goes all swoooosh and flows behind you and detangles like some kind of magical girl transformation like "Maybe she's born with it; Maybe it's Meloetta"-- hey, I bet if I could get a bottle of that, I wouldn't have half the troubled boy problems I have!
ja: 毎朝シャワーから出て「メエェ～」ってやって、それで髪がバサァってなびいて、魔法少女の変身みたいにサラサラになって「生まれつきかしら、それともメロエッタのおかげ?」――ねえ、あれのボトル一本あったら、あたしの男運の悩みも半分は解決すると思うのよね!

key: Wait a minute, do Pokémon even take showers?
en: Wait a minute, do Pokémon even take showers?
ja: 待って、そもそもポケモンってシャワー浴びるの?

key: RINGMASTER: Okay, enough!!!
en: RINGMASTER: Okay, enough!!!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: はい、もう終わり!!!

key: I get it... kinda...
en: I get it... kinda...
ja: 分かった……分かったから……

key: This must be some kind of New World Anomaly crap...
en: This must be some kind of New World Anomaly crap...
ja: これはきっと、ニューワールドのアノマリーってやつね……

key: ...But that doesn't mean we can't use it to rake in the fanfare!
en: ...But that doesn't mean we can't use it to rake in the fanfare!
ja: ……でも、それならそれで、この騒ぎを商売に利用しない手はないわ!

key: Tell you what, everyone, let's make an event out of it!
en: Tell you what, everyone, let's make an event out of it!
ja: ねえみんな、聞いて、これでイベントを一つ作りましょう!

key: Queue up and we'll have a tournament!
en: Queue up and we'll have a tournament!
ja: 列に並んで! トーナメントを開催するわ!

key: Winner gets an exclusive meet and greet autograph sesh with today's apparent star of the show, Meloetta!
en: Winner gets an exclusive meet and greet autograph sesh with today's apparent star of the show, Meloetta!
ja: 優勝者には、今日の主役らしいメロエッタとの限定サイン会をプレゼント!

key: SANTIAGO: Fuck yeah!!!
en: SANTIAGO: Fuck yeah!!!
ja: サンティアゴ: よっしゃあ!!!

key: BREAK: I'm sure this will make for an interesting diversion...
en: BREAK: I'm sure this will make for an interesting diversion...
ja: ブレーク: これは面白い余興になりそうだな……

key: MISS PERCY: Let's go, Meloetta!!!
en: MISS PERCY: Let's go, Meloetta!!!
ja: ミス・パーシー: 行くわよ、メロエッタ!!!

key: RINGMASTER: And to think I pay my staff so much to draw even half this crowd...
en: RINGMASTER: And to think I pay my staff so much to draw even half this crowd...
ja: サーカスだんちょう: これだけの客を集めるのに、スタッフにあんなに給料払ってるっていうのに……

key: SAMSON: You say something, boss?
en: SAMSON: You say something, boss?
ja: サムソン: 何か言ったか、お嬢?

key: RINGMASTER: Nothing that won't be reflected on your paystub!
en: RINGMASTER: Nothing that won't be reflected on your paystub!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: あなたの給料明細に響かないことよ!

key: All right, let's queue up and sign up!
en: All right, let's queue up and sign up!
ja: さあ、みんな並んで登録して!

key: I'll take registry and entry fees up here! Samson, keep them in line, will you?
en: I'll take registry and entry fees up here! Samson, keep them in line, will you?
ja: 受付と参加費はここで受け付けるわ! サムソン、みんなを並ばせておいてくれる?

key: ATTENDEE: What do you mean entry fees?!
en: ATTENDEE: What do you mean entry fees?!
ja: 参加者: 参加費ってどういうことだ!?

key: You trying to scam us?!
en: You trying to scam us?!
ja: 俺たちから金巻き上げるつもりか!?

key: RINGMASTER: It's for administrative costs!
en: RINGMASTER: It's for administrative costs!
ja: サーカスだんちょう: 運営費用のためよ!

key: You're on fairgrounds after all!
en: You're on fairgrounds after all!
ja: だってここ、興行場なんだから!

key: If you wanted to make the rules, YOU try ring-leading this clown fiesta!
en: If you wanted to make the rules, YOU try ring-leading this clown fiesta!
ja: 自分でルール決めたいなら、あなたがこのピエロ祭りを取り仕切ってみなさいよ!

key: MELOETTA: Loo~!
en: MELOETTA: Loo~!
ja: メロエッタ: ロー～!

key: RINGMASTER: Yeah, yeah. I don't wanna hear it from you.
en: RINGMASTER: Yeah, yeah. I don't wanna hear it from you.
ja: サーカスだんちょう: はいはい。あなたにそんなこと言われたくないわ。

key: Besides, where better to have a tournament than our newly-opened Battle Wheel!?
en: Besides, where better to have a tournament than our newly-opened Battle Wheel!?
ja: それに、新装オープンしたばかりのバトルホイール以上に大会にぴったりの場所、他にある!?

key: Once upon a time there was going to be a grand re- opening for it, after SOMEONE trashed it again, but then the world sort of started half-ending?
en: Once upon a time there was going to be a grand re- opening for it, after SOMEONE trashed it again, but then the world sort of started half-ending?
ja: そういえば、誰かさんがまた壊した後、盛大なリニューアルオープンをする予定だったのに、なぜか世界が半分終わりかけちゃったのよね?

key: Or started half-starting...
en: Or started half-starting...
ja: いえ、半分始まりかけたって言うべきかしら……

key: Whatever, Battle Wheel!
en: Whatever, Battle Wheel!
ja: どっちでもいいわ、バトルホイールよ!

key: Every gondola on the ride has a unique field, so you never know what you're gonna get!
en: Every gondola on the ride has a unique field, so you never know what you're gonna get!
ja: ライドのゴンドラは一台ごとに違うフィールドになってるから、何が出るか分からないわよ!

key: There's only room for three Pokémon each in there though, so pick your teams wisely!
en: There's only room for three Pokémon each in there though, so pick your teams wisely!
ja: 乗れるのは各チーム3匹まで、チーム編成は慎重にね!

key: Come talk to me when you're all ready for your match!
en: Come talk to me when you're all ready for your match!
ja: 試合の準備ができたら、あたしに話しかけて!

key: CLOWN 1: The two of us guard the Battle Wheel, but one of us only tells the truth, and the other one always tells lies!
en: CLOWN 1: The two of us guard the Battle Wheel, but one of us only tells the truth, and the other one always tells lies!
ja: ピエロ1: あたしたち二人でバトルホイールを守ってるんだけど、片方は必ず本当のことを言って、もう片方は必ずうそをつくの!

key: CLOWN 2: Hey, you don't need to bring our personal life into this...
en: CLOWN 2: Hey, you don't need to bring our personal life into this...
ja: ピエロ2: おい、そこにプライベートな話を持ち込むなよ……

key: CLOWN 1: One of us will let you into the Battle Wheel when you're ready to begin, but how will you ever figure out which?!
en: CLOWN 1: One of us will let you into the Battle Wheel when you're ready to begin, but how will you ever figure out which?!
ja: ピエロ1: どっちかが、あんたの準備ができたらバトルホイールに入れてくれるんだけど、どっちだか分かるかしら!?

key: CLOWN: If you're ready to begin, pick 3 Pokémon and we'll get this proverbial show on the proverbial road!
en: CLOWN: If you're ready to begin, pick 3 Pokémon and we'll get this proverbial show on the proverbial road!
ja: ピエロ: 準備ができてるなら、ポケモンを3匹選んでくれ、そしたらこの「ショー」とやらを始めようじゃないか!

key: ...or that's what I WOULD say if you had 3!
en: ...or that's what I WOULD say if you had 3!
ja: ……って言いたいところだが、3匹いなきゃな!

key: How you gonna show up to a 3v3 tournament with less than?!
en: How you gonna show up to a 3v3 tournament with less than?!
ja: 3対3の大会に、それ以下の頭数でどう出るつもりだ!?

key: And they say I'm the clown! Sheesh!
en: And they say I'm the clown! Sheesh!
ja: ピエロはこっちのはずなのにな! やれやれ!

key: CLOWN: You got it, pal.
en: CLOWN: You got it, pal.
ja: ピエロ: よし、決まりだな。

key: Now you know how the Battle Wheel works, yeah?
en: Now you know how the Battle Wheel works, yeah?
ja: バトルホイールの仕組みはもう分かってるよな?

key: Every car's a different field!
en: Every car's a different field!
ja: 車両ごとにフィールドが違うんだ!

key: Round and round the wheel goes,
en: Round and round the wheel goes,
ja: ホイールはぐるぐる回る、

key: Which field you get, only Arceus knows!
en: Which field you get, only Arceus knows!
ja: どのフィールドが来るかは、アルセウスのみぞ知る!

key: Don't worry about space, it's bigger on the inside!
en: Don't worry about space, it's bigger on the inside!
ja: スペースの心配はいらないぜ、中は見た目より広いんだ!

key: Now get in there.
en: Now get in there.
ja: さあ、入ってくれ。

key: CLOWN: So fickle, geez...
en: CLOWN: So fickle, geez...
ja: ピエロ: 気まぐれな奴だな、やれやれ……

key: We ain't quite ready for you yet, bucko!
en: We ain't quite ready for you yet, bucko!
ja: まだあんたの準備ができてないんだよ、兄ちゃん!

key: CLOWN: If you're ready for the next round, pick your 3 Pokémon!
en: CLOWN: If you're ready for the next round, pick your 3 Pokémon!
ja: ピエロ: 次のラウンドの準備ができたら、ポケモンを3匹選んでくれ!

key: That's the show!
en: That's the show!
ja: それがショーってもんだ!

key: Shoulda pet the Glaceon.
en: Shoulda pet the Glaceon.
ja: グレイシアをなでておくべきだったな。

key: CLOWN: So, you came out on top, eh?
en: CLOWN: So, you came out on top, eh?
ja: ピエロ: で、あんたが勝ち残ったってわけか?

key: Not bad!
en: Not bad!
ja: 悪くないぜ!

key: Here's your other Pokémon, and I'll get yours healed up!
en: Here's your other Pokémon, and I'll get yours healed up!
ja: もう一匹のポケモンだ、あんたのポケモンは回復させとくよ!

key: CLOWN: Talk to the Ringmaster, and she should announce the winners and next pairings!
en: CLOWN: Talk to the Ringmaster, and she should announce the winners and next pairings!
ja: ピエロ: 団長に話しかけてくれ、勝者と次の組み合わせを発表してくれるはずだ!

key: I guess that's that!
en: I guess that's that!
ja: まあ、そういうことだな!

key: Here's your other Pokémon!
en: Here's your other Pokémon!
ja: もう一匹のポケモンだ!

key: Congrats on the win! Just talk to the Ringmaster for your prize!
en: Congrats on the win! Just talk to the Ringmaster for your prize!
ja: 優勝おめでとう! 賞品は団長に話しかけてくれ!

key: CLOWN: Oof, you made it so far only to lose now, huh, chump?
en: CLOWN: Oof, you made it so far only to lose now, huh, chump?
ja: ピエロ: うわ、せっかくここまで来たのに負けちまうとはな、間抜け野郎。

key: I mean, champ.
en: I mean, champ.
ja: いや、チャンプだったな。

key: Well, I guess that's what you get for not petting the Glaceon!
en: Well, I guess that's what you get for not petting the Glaceon!
ja: まあ、グレイシアをなでなかった罰ってやつだろうな!

key: Yep, we overheard.
en: Yep, we overheard.
ja: ああ、聞いてたぜ。

key: For shame.
en: For shame.
ja: 情けねえこった。

key: We may be clowns, but you really look the fool here!
en: We may be clowns, but you really look the fool here!
ja: 俺たちはピエロだが、あんたの方がよっぽど道化に見えるぜ!

key: CLOWN: Whasha-what?!
en: CLOWN: Whasha-what?!
ja: ピエロ: な、なんだって!?

key: That Pokémon just came cutting through here and jumped into a gondola!
en: That Pokémon just came cutting through here and jumped into a gondola!
ja: あのポケモン、ここを突っ切ってゴンドラに飛び込んだぞ!

key: You goin' after it?
en: You goin' after it?
ja: 追いかけるのか?

key: CLOWN: Hop to it!
en: CLOWN: Hop to it!
ja: ピエロ: 行ってこい!

key: I ain't gonna take your other 'Mons this time; you'll need everything you got!
en: I ain't gonna take your other 'Mons this time; you'll need everything you got!
ja: 今回はもう一匹のポケモンは取り上げないぜ、持ってる全部が必要になるだろうからな!

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 幸運を!

key: CLOWN: Whasha-wha-huhhhh?!
en: CLOWN: Whasha-wha-huhhhh?!
ja: ピエロ: な、な、なんだって、ええぇ!?

key: CLOWN: It's not me.
en: CLOWN: It's not me.
ja: ピエロ: 俺じゃないぞ。

key: I'll let you in on a secret--
en: I'll let you in on a secret--
ja: 秘密を教えてやろう――

key: I'm not even a real clown.
en: I'm not even a real clown.
ja: 俺、実はピエロじゃないんだ。

key: I'm just a guy dressed up as a clown!
en: I'm just a guy dressed up as a clown!
ja: ただピエロの格好をした男ってだけでな!

key: It's different, you see?
en: It's different, you see?
ja: それって違うだろ、分かるか?

key: Say, did something happen?
en: Say, did something happen?
ja: ねえ、何かあったの?

key: CIEL: I'll thank you for humoring a silly girl's momentary fancies.
en: CIEL: I'll thank you for humoring a silly girl's momentary fancies.
ja: シエル: くだらない乙女の気まぐれに付き合ってくれて、感謝するわ。

key: It is so exhausting to be in performance mode all the time,
en: It is so exhausting to be in performance mode all the time,
ja: ずっと演じ続けているのは、とても疲れるものなの、

key: And yet, I'm never quite so good at knowing when to let myself step off the stage.
en: And yet, I'm never quite so good at knowing when to let myself step off the stage.
ja: なのに、いつ舞台から降りればいいのか、なかなか分からないままなのよ。

key: When you first arrived, for instance-- a run of the mill challenger, no?
en: When you first arrived, for instance-- a run of the mill challenger, no?
ja: たとえば、あなたが最初にここに来たときのこと――ただのありふれた挑戦者、そうでしょう?

key: Why should I think twice?
en: Why should I think twice?
ja: なぜ考え直す必要があったのかしら?

key: Why should I let my hair down?
en: Why should I let my hair down?
ja: なぜ気を許す必要があったのかしら?

key: And yet here we are.
en: And yet here we are.
ja: なのに、今こうしているわね。
